name: rosetta-tau-number
code:
use default

divisor_count(n: int) -> int is
    let count mut = 0
    let divisor mut = 1

    while divisor * divisor <= n do
        if n % divisor == 0 then
            count = count + 2
        fi

        if divisor * divisor == n then
            count = count - 1
        fi

        divisor = divisor + 1
    od

    count
si

is_tau(n: int) -> bool => n % divisor_count(n) == 0

let first_hundred = stream(1, n => n || n + 1)
    |> filter(is_tau)
    |> take(100)
    |> collect()

first_hundred |> chunk(10)
    |> each(row => write_line(row |> map((n: int) => "{n,6}") |> join("")))
